## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: mixed sector breadth (6/11) and Broad leadership among Top 5 (5 sectors), while major large-cap techs show short-term divergences—no clear directional read.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: CEG (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +14.22%) ABOVE TREND, SO (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +9.66%) ABOVE TREND, XEL (1W: +4.86% | 1M: +10.33%) ABOVE TREND. Materials/Energy cyclical strength: FCX (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +12.51%) ABOVE TREND, OXY (1W: +8.13% | 1M: +15.98%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Financials lag: JPM (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +0.75%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -4.52%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -3.41%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary and Technology show mixed/negative internals with notable tech losers (ORCL, IBM, ACN).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?

5. Worst Performing Stocks?

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: PYPL (1W: +14.16% | 1M: -16.40%) RECOVERY, CEG (1W: +10.81% | 1M: +14.22%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +12.51%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE among large caps (MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN, TSLA showing 1W gains vs 1M weakness) — tactical moves, not full confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-cautious. AAPL (1W: +3.74% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.08% | 1M: +23.78%) ABOVE TREND, while ORCL (1W: -5.30% | 1M: -18.94%) BELOW TREND and IBM (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -19.38%) BELOW TREND — sector internals mixed.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft overall with pockets of strength. JPM (1W: -1.77% | 1M: +0.75%) CORRECTION, V (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -4.52%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: -3.52% | 1M: -3.41%) BELOW TREND; top cyclical banks not broadly confirming leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive undercurrent but mixed signals. JNJ (1W: +0.07% | 1M: +10.69%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: -1.02% | 1M: +4.68%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: +0.81% | 1M: -3.03%) RECOVERY — sector showing selective strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to current leaders: Utilities (CEG, XEL), Materials/Energy cyclicals (FCX, OXY), and select techs (AMAT, NVDA) while reducing exposure to lagging large-cap techs and weak financial names. Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat tech large-cap short-term strength as tactical given 1M weakness.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +7.08% | 1M: +23.78%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +12.51%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through. BEARISH: ORCL (1W: -5.30% | 1M: -18.94%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -4.93% | 1M: -21.38%) BELOW TREND — at risk of further downside.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (CEG, SO, XEL) — defensive leadership with confirmed ABOVE TREND names. BEARISH: Technology internals and Financials — mixed leadership and multiple big-cap divergences.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
AMAT 1W strength sustain above recent pivot (monitor 1W follow-through) — AMAT (1W: +7.08% | 1M: +23.78%) ABOVE TREND. NVDA resistance test on guidance follow-through — NVDA (1W: +4.03% | 1M: +4.87%) ABOVE TREND. PYPL short-term reversal watch if 1W momentum fades — PYPL (1W: +14.16% | 1M: -16.40%) RECOVERY.

PYPL (+85): PayPal Surges on Stripe Acquisition Interest; PYPL (1W: +14.16% | 1M: -16.40%) RECOVERY — short-term confirmation, longer-term distribution. SO (+80): DOE loan support; SO (1W: +5.36% | 1M: +9.66%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price. FCX (+80): Grasberg rights; FCX (1W: +10.02% | 1M: +12.51%) ABOVE TREND — news and price aligned.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-55): EU antitrust push; META (1W: +1.63% | 1M: -2.78%) RECOVERY — news diverging from 1W strength. F (-55): Ford Q4 issues; F (not in detailed list) flagged by sentiment—monitor. IBM (-45): AI concerns cited; IBM (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -19.38%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by price.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive and Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5). Utilities and Materials/Energy showing strength (CEG ABOVE TREND, FCX ABOVE TREND, OXY ABOVE TREND) while several large-cap techs exhibit RECOVERY patterns. Key risk: MAJOR divergence among big caps (MSFT, GOOGL, META, AMZN, TSLA 1W up vs 1M down) and mixed sentiment (PYPL, PFE) — watch for confirmed breadth expansion before enlarging positions.
